{
  "title": "Project Nexus: AI-Driven 3D Product Configurator & Concierge Module",
  "full_brd_markdown": "# Business Requirements Document (BRD)

## 1. Executive Summary
**Project Name:** Project Nexus
**Objective:** To develop a high-performance, immersive website module that integrates a 3D product configurator with an autonomous AI sales agent. This module aims to bridge the gap between static e-commerce and physical retail by providing a high-fidelity, interactive, and personalized shopping experience.

## 2. Business Objectives
- **Increase Conversion Rates:** Leverage interactive 3D visualization to reduce buyer hesitation.
- **Reduce Support Overhead:** Utilize AI Agents to handle complex product queries and configuration logic.
- **Future-Proofing:** Implement a headless, scalable architecture using Next.js to ensure high performance and SEO dominance.

## 3. Functional Requirements

### 3.1. High-Performance Web Core (Next.js)
- **SSR & ISR Implementation:** Use Server-Side Rendering for dynamic product pages and Incremental Static Regeneration for high-traffic catalog updates to maintain optimal Core Web Vitals.
- **Headless CMS Integration:** Seamlessly pull product metadata and marketing copy from a headless provider (e.g., Contentful or Strapi).
- **App Router Architecture:** Utilize the Next.js App Router for optimized nested layouts and streaming server components.

### 3.2. Immersive 3D Configurator (Three.js)
- **Interactive 3D Rendering:** Real-time rendering of product models with high-fidelity textures and lighting.
- **Dynamic Customization:** Users must be able to change materials, colors, and components in real-time.
- **Spatial Hotspots:** Interactive points on the 3D model that trigger informational tooltips or AI agent explanations.
- **WebXR Support:** Enable an 'AR View' for mobile users to project the 3D model into their physical space.

### 3.3. Autonomous AI Concierge (AI Agents)
- **RAG-Powered Knowledge Base:** An agentic workflow using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to answer technical product questions based on internal documentation.
- **Agentic Workflow Orchestration:** The AI should be able to perform actions (e.g., "Add this configuration to cart," "Check stock for this color") using LangChain or LlamaIndex.
- **Multimodal Interaction:** Support for both text-based chat and voice-activated commands to guide the 3D configuration process.

## 4. Non-Functional Requirements
- **Performance:** Initial 3D model load time under 2.5 seconds on 4G connections.
- **Scalability:** Architecture must support multi-tenant deployments for different product lines.
- **Accessibility:** Ensure the AI interface and 3D navigation meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards.

## 5. User Stories
- **As a Customer:** I want to see a 3D version of the product so I can understand its scale and features before buying.
- **As a Customer:** I want to ask an AI assistant about the compatibility of different parts so I don't make a mistake in my order.
- **As a Marketing Manager:** I want the module to be SEO-friendly so that our custom configurations appear in search results.

## 6. Technical Constraints & Stack
- **Frontend:** Next.js 14+, Tailwind CSS.
- **3D Engine:** Three.js / React Three Fiber.
- **AI Framework:** LangChain with OpenAI GPT-4o or Llama 3 (fine-tuned).
- **Infrastructure:** AWS (utilizing Premier Tier patterns for cloud-native scaling).",
  "sprint_priority": "high"
}
